close_results.citation: Yair Caro, Randy Davila, Michael Henning, Ryan Pepper, Conjecture(s) of TxGraffiti: Independence, domination, and matchings, arXiv:2104.01092 (2021)
close_results.relation: Contains a distinct 3/5 lower bound for edge domination number versus matching number in connected cubic graphs, not ordinary domination number on trees.
Searches also surfaced the standard upper relation gamma(G) <= matching_number(G) for graphs without isolated vertices, not a lower bound matching TF-000998.
